source: FDD 14.1 and 14.2, LLD 9.5 and 9.5.1. DRAFT: every value is owned by the style specialist (FOI-2, FOI-8, FOI-9). Values marked 'assumed' in the notes are not in the documents and need the specialist's confirmation.

thresholds.dark_lightness_note: assumed: FDD R1 Party says 'dark or statement tops' without a number. 'Statement' = bold (chroma above bold_chroma_above).

cool_seasons_note: assumed: FDD R5 says 'cool seasons' without listing them.
layer_decision_note: Fix loop 1, decision D-A (orchestrator, 2026-11-04). FDD 14.1 R2 says to add a layer in cool seasons and R1 says 'blazer if available' for Formal; LLD 9.5 only scores the layer (R5). The FDD wins as a hard rule WHEN an eligible layer exists: in a cool season (cool_seasons) and for Formal (layer_required_if_available) an outfit without a layer, or a Suit or Tuxedo standing in for it, is dropped if at least one layered outfit exists among the candidates. With no layered outfit possible the layer-less outfit is allowed and R5 penalises it.

Summer.note: FDD R2: no coats or heavy knits. Which sub-types are heavy knits is assumed: Sweater and Cardigan.

Autumn.note: DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: Sandals are not worn in autumn. The FDD names no such exclusion; the style specialist may overrule it.

Winter.note: DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: no Shorts, Sports shorts or Sandals in winter; Sports shorts are exempt for the Sport occasion (exempt lists the sub-types an occasion keeps). The FDD names no such exclusion; the style specialist may overrule it.

Casual.note: FDD R1: any tops and bottoms except formal shoes with shorts. Sports shorts counted as shorts (assumed). DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: Suit and Tuxedo are not Casual bottoms; Formal shoes are not worn with a T-shirt, Polo or Hoodie (as top or layer). The FDD allows the specialist to set these.

Work.note: FDD R1: shirt or polo, chinos or trousers, closed shoes (Sandals are open). DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: the layer list leaves out Hoodie, Track jacket and Jacket (the taxonomy has no windcheater sub-type, so Jacket, which holds windcheaters, is left out; Sherwani also); no Printed or Graphic tops; at most one bold item among top, bottom, layer and shoes (max_bold_items, a hard rule; a belt is scored under R3 only); at most two non-neutral colour families (scored in R3).

Formal.note: FDD R1: shirt, tailored trousers, formal shoes, blazer if available. Suit and Tuxedo (one item in layer and bottom) are allowed because they hold the blazer and trousers (assumed). The layer is optional only when no layered outfit exists (layer_required_if_available, see layer_decision_note). DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: at most two non-neutral colour families (scored in R3).

Party.note: FDD R1: dark or statement tops, jeans or trousers, clean sneakers or boots. 'Clean' is not checked.

Sport.note: FDD R1: activewear for the top and bottom, sneakers for footwear. DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: the layer is limited to Track jacket, Hoodie and Jacket.

Date.note: FDD 14.1 says Date uses the Casual rule and that the specialist may set it. DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: Date has its own entry: no Sports T-shirt, Sports shorts or Track pants, the Casual footwear pairs, and at most two non-neutral colour families (scored in R3). Suit and Tuxedo are not removed for Date (the review names Casual and Travel only).

Travel.note: FDD 14.1 says Travel uses the Casual rule and that the specialist may set it. DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: Travel has its own entry: no Sports T-shirt, Sports shorts, Track pants, Suit or Tuxedo, and the Casual footwear pairs.

clashing_family_pairs_note: DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah: two non-neutral colour families of a pair in one outfit take penalties.clashing_pair off R3, once for each pair present. A scored rule, not a hard one.

penalties.note: DRAFT (WO-0004): no document gives these magnitudes. They are invented placeholders so R3 to R6 and R7 can be scored; the style specialist owns them (FOI-9) and must confirm or replace every value. Each is taken off a 0 to 1 rule value, which never goes below 0.
penalties.families_over_three_note: R3: taken once for each distinct non-neutral colour family beyond the occasion's limit: three, or max_non_neutral_families (two for Work, Formal and Date, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah).
penalties.clashing_pair_note: R3: taken once for each pair in clashing_family_pairs present in the outfit (AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah).
penalties.extra_bold_note: R3: taken once for each bold item beyond the first.
penalties.extra_pattern_note: R4: taken once for each patterned item beyond the first.
penalties.missing_layer_note: R5: taken in a cool season when the outfit has no layer.
penalties.layer_same_family_note: R5: taken in a cool season when the layer's colour family equals the top's.
penalties.belt_shoe_mismatch_note: R6: taken when a belt and the shoes are in different colour families.
penalties.variety_reuse_note: R7: taken from the score of a candidate once for each of its items already in a chosen suggestion.

reason_templates.note: R8: the only sentences a suggestion may use. Placeholders: {occasion}, {season}, {colours}. DRAFT wording, owned by the style specialist. r1 and r2 reworded by the AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah.
reason_templates.r2: Nothing is out of season for {season}
reason_templates.r_tagged_note: Used only when the occasion_fit part is exactly 1 (every item carries the occasion tag), and then it comes right after r2. DRAFT, AI style review 2026-11-04, pending Arpan Shah.
reason_templates.r3_neutral_one: {colours} is neutral and goes with anything
reason_templates.r3_neutral_many: {colours} are neutral and go with anything
reason_templates.r4: At most one pattern, so nothing clashes
reason_templates.r6: Belt and shoes share a colour family
